recipe.visualDefinition: A 1960s-style album cover featuring a four-man vocal group in dynamic, expressive poses against a textured teal studio backdrop, framed by a thick white border and topped with high-contrast, multi-layered typography.
coreVisualRelationships: The vibrant green satin jackets contrast sharply against the deep teal background.
The white framing line separates the central photographic subject from the outer teal margin.
The heavy, condensed orange title anchors the top edge, balanced by the white outlined subtitle below it.
coreInvariants: Green satin jackets with black cuffs and collars
Strict rectangular white border framing the subjects

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four men arranged in a staggered, diagonal formation occupying the central 70% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure's reaching hand and the bright orange title text at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold orange title, move down to the group's expressive hands, and follow the diagonal lean of the bodies.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant teal space around the group within the white frame to emphasize their silhouettes.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the jackets and title; muted, dark values in the background and trousers.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The ampersand in the subtitle is stylized and thin.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Weight and fill contrast: Solid bold orange paired with thin white outlines of the same typeface family.

preserve: Outline treatment for the second line

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy, condensed verticality of the main title.
Provides the clean, modern-retro condensed look for the outlines.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of four men in 1960s hairstyles wearing shiny emerald green satin bomber jackets and black trousers. They are in dynamic, joyful dancing poses with hands reaching toward the camera. The background is a textured, dark teal studio wall. Surround the image with a thin white rectangular border and a thick teal outer margin.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, extra-condensed bold sans-serif title in orange at the top. Below it, add a medium-sized condensed sans-serif subtitle using only white outlines. Below that, add a list of song titles in small white uppercase sans-serif text separated by dots.

verificationChecks: Is the title text orange and extra-condensed?
Are the jackets specifically green satin with black trim?
Is there a white rectangular frame around the subjects?
Is the background a textured teal?

adjustableVariables: Number of figures in the group
mustRedesign: Record label logo in the corner

mustAchieve: Authentic 1960s film grain and studio lighting
High-sheen texture on the satin jackets

postGenerationChecks: Check that the satin jackets have realistic highlights.
Ensure the white border is perfectly rectangular and centered.
Verify the orange title is the most dominant visual element.
Confirm the poses look like mid-century dance moves.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a group studio portrait + apply a textured teal backdrop + frame with a white line + top with heavy condensed orange and outlined white typography.
